acceptanceCriteria: A stacked lane on a sealed predecessor can bind and seal only its own hunks, or a documented route is tested
The too-many-obligations refusal names the stacked-predecessor cause when the BASE diff contains another sealed CEM's change
body: Lane tasks-speed-1021f (#1442, BASE ae3b418152fe4c42f52ac7cfdc16ecc12159607e) built on #1436 by merging it into the branch. dogfood-change then bound 58 hunks including #1436's whole diff, ocm-aggregate returned too-many-obligations, and dogfood-check failed with dogfood-report-drift on the second try, so the lane could not seal (NOT_PRODUCED). Expected: a lane stacked on an unmerged, already-sealed predecessor can bind only its own hunks (for example by binding against the predecessor head as BASE, with the predecessor's seal cited), or the charter documents the supported stacking route.

completion.reason: Delivered on main 58d4ed2d309d5dc1afc21c127647d2e22b1bed3f via batch beamfall/corvint#1444 (lane #1443); CI green on that commit (runs 39652657524,39651357281). title: Lane that merges a sealed predecessor PR inflates its dogfood change to too-many-obligations and cannot seal
